# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| signal-analysis-report | `assets/signal-analysis-report.md`, filled | `deploy-acceptance`, `catalog-compatibility` | How the machine works written down; Context sources used and confidence recorded; No analyser blockers; Capability requirement set covered; A second plant's instance can consume it |
| signal-binding-sheet | `assets/signal-binding-sheet.md`, one row per signal | `mi-flow`, `deploy-acceptance` | Each row carries canonical name, unit, scale, value type, delta meaning, setpoint or actual, consumers and collection method |
| derived-output-spec | Rule-engine spec (pattern, inputs, output name and unit, priority order for states) | `mi-flow` | Each derived signal has a new UUID registered on the edge platform first; Raw and derived named explicitly |
| signals-the-plc-must-expose-machine-spec | List with class and owner | `mi-equipment` | Each gap names its owner (machine or engineering vs edge configuration) |
| proposed-standard-change | Proposal | IIAE (consultation) | Evidence cited: analyser check id, context source and confidence, standard clause |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `funnel-evaluation`, `ops-event-model`, `mi-equipment`, `mi-data-availability`, `funnel-requirements`
- **Next:** mi-flow (step 3b4), then deploy-acceptance (step 3b6); catalog-compatibility receives the report and binding sheet.: `mi-flow`, `deploy-acceptance`, `catalog-compatibility`
- **Stops here when:** the analyser reports blockers (raw PLC tag, name collision, mixed script, missing or duplicate UUID, capability gap), or only a tag list exists without machine context
- **Stops here when:** Not standardizing is a valid outcome, recorded as a decision
- **Stops here when:** Do not fix a gap downstream in a flow or query
